title: Social launch animation

location.extent: Complete published clip; PNG is a frame at 0.5 seconds

slide_intent: Show expression within a platform frame because branded content must remain identifiable amid another interface.
strategic_value: The moving patterns can introduce Dropbox’s new visual world while the phone context demonstrates a social placement.
demonstration: A phone displays a social post; a short welcome message appears before colored patterned forms fill both the post and the surrounding ochre field.
practical_value: Compare the bounded social post with the expanded presentation treatment around it.

content_islands.name: Phone and interface
content_islands.spec: Keep the white handset and social controls fixed during the animation.

content_islands.name: Expanding pattern
content_islands.spec: Follow the colored forms as they spread within and outside the phone frame.
